title_zh: 針對懲教人員的診斷專屬網上認知行為治療：隨機對照試驗
title_en: Diagnosis-specific online CBT for correctional staff: randomised controlled trial
summary_zh: 隨機對照試驗，以懲教人員為對象比較診斷專屬網上認知行為治療（eCBT）與常規照顧（TAU）。eCBT 組症狀嚴重度下降 61.37%，TAU 組為 23.29%，效果量 Cohen's d=0.68，混合線性模型顯示組間差異具統計意義。
summary_en: Randomised controlled trial comparing diagnosis-specific online CBT (eCBT) with treatment as usual (TAU) among correctional staff. Symptom severity fell 61.37% in the eCBT group versus 23.29% in TAU (Cohen's d=0.68), with significant group differences in mixed linear models. Authors are from Providence Care Hospital, Canada.
evidence_note: 隨機對照試驗；效果量與百分比來自原文摘要
brief_zh: RCT 設計，對象為懲教人員這類高壓職業群體
eCBT 組症狀下降幅度明顯大於常規照顧組
樣本與追蹤期等細節需以原文核對
supervision_questions: 在高壓職業群體中，網上 CBT 可以怎樣與面對面服務配合？

related.title_zh: 短程 EMDR 用於人格障礙：荷蘭 RCT 顯示五週十次後症狀與診斷狀態改善
related.title_en: Brief EMDR for personality disorders RCT
related.summary_zh: Mental Elf 評介一項荷蘭兩所門診的隨機對照試驗（JAMA Network Open, 2025）：159 名人格障礙成人隨機分到 EMDR（每週兩次、共十次 90 分鐘）或候補名單。三個月追蹤時，以 ADP-IV 衡量 EMDR 組 44.1% 不再符合人格障礙標準，控制組 15.8%；人格障礙症狀、人格功能與情緒調節亦改善，中止率僅 5.1%、未報告不良事件。評論者提醒對照組是候補名單、追蹤期短。
related.summary_en: A Mental Elf blog reviews a Dutch RCT (JAMA Network Open, 2025) in which 159 adults with personality disorders received ten 90-minute EMDR sessions over five weeks or waiting list. At three-month follow-up, 44.1% of the EMDR group no longer met PD criteria on the ADP-IV versus 15.8% of controls, with gains in PD symptoms, personality functioning and emotion regulation, 5.1% dropout and no reported adverse events. The reviewer notes the waiting-list comparator and short follow-up.

related.title_zh: N170 潛伏期作為自閉症 arbaclofen 治療反應 EEG 生物標記的首次評估
related.title_en: First evaluation of N170 latency as an EEG biomarker of treatment response in an arbaclofe
related.summary_zh: 在 122 名 5–17 歲自閉症兒童青少年的 arbaclofen 雙盲 RCT 中，N170 潛伏期在 16 週內保持穩定，藥物未改變 N170；基線 N170 亦未能預測社交功能的變化。研究同時證實多中心自閉症藥物試驗整合 EEG 的可行性。
related.summary_en: In a 122-participant RCT of arbaclofen in autistic children, N170 latency did not change with treatment and baseline N170 did not predict outcome; EEG integration in multi-site trials proved feasible.

related.title_zh: 正向童年經驗與成年早期心理健康的長期追蹤研究
related.title_en: Positive childhood experiences reduce risk of later mental illness: longitudinal cohort
related.summary_zh: 縱向追蹤研究（發表於 American Journal of Psychiatry，2026 年 10 月 14 日，doi:10.1176/appi.ajp.20260007）。正向童年經驗（PCE）分數每增加 1 分（最高 10 分），成年早期符合精神障礙準則的機會率下降約 11%。
related.summary_en: Longitudinal study published in the American Journal of Psychiatry on 14 October 2026 (doi:10.1176/appi.ajp.20260007). Each one-point increase in positive childhood experiences (PCE, up to 10) was associated with about 11% lower odds of meeting criteria for a psychiatric disorder in early adulthood, after adjusting for confounders.
